# DevFolio — a free, open-source Next.js portfolio template

DevFolio is a free and open-source developer portfolio template for Next.js 16
(App Router) with React 19 and TypeScript. It is MIT licensed: clone it, change
the content, ship it commercially, no attribution required.

The demo content belongs to a fictional full-stack engineer, Arjun Mehta.

## What it is

- A production-quality portfolio: home, projects index, per-project case study,
  about, contact and a "built with" credit page.
- Dark mode by default, with a light / dark / system toggle that persists to
  localStorage and is applied before first paint, so there is no theme flash.
- Server components by default; client boundaries only where interaction needs
  them (navbar sheet, theme toggle, counters, copy button, contact form).
- No backend and no authentication. All content is typed mock data in /data.

## Stack

- Next.js 16.3.x, App Router, Turbopack, async request APIs
- React 19, TypeScript 5, Node.js 20.9+ (22 LTS recommended)
- VivekUI (@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui) v0.5.x for every UI component and both charts
- No Tailwind, no shadcn, no MUI, no CSS framework of any kind. Custom styling is
  plain CSS in app/globals.css.

## Routes

- /             Home: hero, tech marquee, stats with a sparkline, a six-tile
                project bento, work timeline, testimonials, FAQ, closing CTA
- /projects     All case studies
- /projects/[slug]  One case study: Problem, Approach, Result, screenshots,
                metrics, previous/next
- /about        Bio, grouped skills, education timeline, a bar chart of projects
                shipped per year
- /contact      A form that validates and confirms with a toast (no backend)
- /built-with   Every section of the site mapped to the component that renders it

## Charts

Two, both pure inline SVG from VivekUI, each with a visually hidden data table:

- Sparkline — twelve weeks of open-source weekly downloads, on the homepage
- BarChart — projects shipped per year 2019–2026, on /about

## SEO and structured data

Metadata API per route with canonical URLs and OpenGraph/Twitter cards,
app/sitemap.ts, app/robots.ts, exactly one h1 per page, and JSON-LD for Person
and WebSite on the homepage, CreativeWork per case study, BreadcrumbList on inner
pages, and FAQPage for the homepage questions.

## Credit

Built with VivekUI (@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui), a free React component library
with zero runtime dependencies, by Vivek Kumar Singh.

Install: npm i @the_viveksingh/vivek-ui

- Docs: https://ui.vivekkumarsingh.in/docs
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui
- GitHub: https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/vivek_UI
- Author: https://vivekkumarsingh.in/

VivekUI ships 91 accessible React components and 6 SVG charts with zero runtime
dependencies. Setup is one npm install and one CSS import — no Tailwind, no
PostCSS plugin, no config file, no required provider.
